tools.name: planable_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this token can access, with their timezone, approval settings and labels. Start here to get a workspaceId. Planable API: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: planable_list_pages
tools.description: List the social pages (accounts) connected to a workspace, with their network and id. Use the page ids in planable_list_posts and planable_create_post. Planable API: GET /pages.

tools.name: planable_get_page_metrics
tools.description: Get follower and engagement metrics for one connected page over a date range (up to 90 results per call). Planable API: GET /pages/{id}/metrics.

tools.name: planable_list_members
tools.description: List the members of a workspace (name, role and id). Use a member id as an approver in planable_request_post_approval. Planable API: GET /members.

tools.name: planable_list_posts
tools.description: List posts in a workspace, optionally filtered by page, campaign, scheduled or created date range. Returns status, approval state, scheduled time and text. Planable API: GET /posts.

tools.name: planable_get_post
tools.description: Get one post with its text, media, labels, scheduled time, status and approval details. Planable API: GET /posts/{id}.

tools.name: planable_get_post_metrics
tools.description: Get the engagement metrics of one published post. Planable API: GET /posts/{id}/metrics.

tools.name: planable_list_post_comments
tools.description: List the internal comments on one post (team discussion, not public comments). Planable API: GET /posts/{id}/comments.

tools.name: planable_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of a workspace, optionally by status. Planable API: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: planable_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its dates, status, description and links. Planable API: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: planable_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels of a workspace. Use label names in planable_create_post. Planable API: GET /labels.

tools.name: planable_list_media
tools.description: List the media uploads in a workspace library (images and videos, with their ids and URLs). Planable API: GET /media.

tools.name: planable_get_media
tools.description: Get one media upload by id, with its status and URL. Planable API: GET /media/{id}.

tools.name: planable_create_post
tools.description: Create a post draft in a workspace. The post follows the workspace approval settings: it is not published by this call. Give pageIds or pageId to choose the connected pages. Planable API: POST /posts.

tools.name: planable_update_post
tools.description: Change the text, schedule, labels, media, first comment or campaign of an existing post. Approval fields cannot be set here. Planable API: PATCH /posts/{id}.

tools.name: planable_request_post_approval
tools.description: Send a post to approvers in its workspace approval flow. This does not approve the post. Planable API: POST /posts/{id}/request-approval.

tools.name: planable_add_post_comment
tools.description: Add an internal comment to a post, or reply to one comment. Clients see it only when the post is not team-only. Planable API: POST /posts/{id}/comments.

tools.name: planable_create_label
tools.description: Create a coloured label in a workspace. Planable API: POST /labels.

tools.name: planable_upload_media
tools.description: Upload 1 to 20 public image or video URLs into a workspace media library. Each file is limited to about 100 MB. Planable API: POST /media.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: planable_list_posts, planable_get_post, planable_get_post_metrics, planable_list_post_comments, planable_list_media, planable_get_media · Private data: planable_list_workspaces, planable_upload_media · Public sink: planable_get_post, planable_get_post_metrics, planable_list_post_comments, planable_get_media, planable_create_post, planable_update_post, planable_request_post_approval, planable_add_post_comment, planable_create_label, planable_upload_media.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: planable_list_posts, planable_get_post, planable_get_post_metrics, planable_list_post_comments, planable_list_media, planable_get_media · Private data: planable_list_workspaces, planable_upload_media · Public sink: planable_get_post, planable_get_post_metrics, planable_list_post_comments, planable_get_media, planable_create_post, planable_update_post, planable_request_post_approval, planable_add_post_comment, planable_create_label, planable_upload_media

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
